title: Visualization of pRps6-positive cells in larval zebrafish brains using immunofluorescence
author: Doszyn, Dulski, et al.
materials:
Timing: 1–2 h
1.Prepare 20× Tricaine stock solution for larvae euthanasia.a.Dissolve 1 g of Tricaine in 244.75 mL of MilliQ H2O.b.Dissolve 60.57 g of Tris base in 450 mL of MilliQ H2O to obtain a 1 M solution. Adjust the pH to 9 with HCl, and top up the volume to 500 mL with MilliQ H2O.c.Add 5.25 mL of 1 M Tris buffer to the Tricaine solution.d.Store at 4°C.2.Prepare TE buffer for DNA extraction (if genotyping of larvae is required).a.Dissolve 60.57 g of Tris base in 450 mL of MilliQ H2O to obtain a 1 M solution. Adjust the pH to 8 with HCl, and top up the volume to 500 mL with MilliQ H2O.b.Dissolve 73.06 g of EDTA in 450 mL of MilliQ H2O to obtain a 0.5 M solution. Adjust the pH to 8 with NaOH, and top up the volume to 500 mL with MilliQ H2O.c.Add 5 mL of the Tris solution and 1 mL of the EDTA solution to 500 mL of MilliQ H2O.d.Autoclave and store at 20°C–22°C.3.Prepare 60× stock solution of the E3 medium for the maintenance of larvae (recipe included in materials and equipment). Autoclave and keep at 4°C.a.Prepare the E3 medium by diluting the stock to 1× in MilliQ H2O.4.Prepare 10% KOH solution for tissue clearing.a.Dissolve 5 g of solid KOH in 50 mL of ddH2O.b.Store at 4°C.5.Prepare PBSTr solution for washing and permeabilization.a.Add 0.2% of Triton X-100 to PBS (e.g., add 100 μL Triton X-100 to prepare 50 mL of PBSTr solution).b.Store at 4°C.
CRITICAL: undiluted Triton X-100 should be handled under a chemical hood.
6.Prepare PBSTr-DMSO solution for washing and permeabilization.a.Add 0.2% of Triton X-100 and 20% DMSO to PBS (e.g., add 100 μL Triton X-100 and 10 mL DMSO to prepare 50 mL of PBSTr-DMSO solution).b.Store at 4°C.7.Prepare PBSTr-DMSO-Tween solution for washing and permeabilization.a.Add 0.2% of Triton X-100, 20% DMSO and 0.1% TWEEN 20 to PBS (e.g., add 100 μL Triton X-100, 10 mL DMSO, and 50 μL TWEEN 20 to prepare 50 mL of PBSTr-DMSO-Tween solution).b.Store at 4°C.8.Prepare 150 mM Tris buffer for antigen retrieval.a.Dissolve 9.0855 g of Tris base in 450 mL of ddH2O.b.Adjust the pH to 9 with HCl.c.Transfer the buffer to a volumetric flask and adjust to 500 mL with ddH2O.d.Transfer to a clean and sterile glass bottle.9.Prepare 2× GDB-Tr blocking solution.a.Add 0.4% gelatin and 0.2% Triton X-100 to PBS (e.g., add 10 mL Gelatin solution and 100 μL Triton X-100 to prepare 50 mL of 2× GDB-Tr blocking solution).b.Aliquot and store at −20°C.10.Prepare PBST-heparin solution for washing and antibody dilution.a.Add 0.2% TWEEN 20 and 10 μg/mL heparin salt to PBS (e.g., add 100 μL TWEEN 20 and 50 μL of prepared 10 mg/mL heparin salt stock).b.Store at 4°C.11.Prepare mounting medium.a.Dissolve 1 g of propyl gallate in 45 mL of glycerol.b.Add 5 mL of PBS, mix using a magnetic stirrer.c.Aliquot and store at −20°C protected from light.12.Prepare a 2% low melting point agarose solution for imaging.a.Dissolve low melting point agarose in 1× E3 medium to the final concentration of 2%.b.If not prepared immediately before imaging, aliquot and store at 4°C.13.Prepare 36% paraformaldehyde stock for fixation.a.Dissolve paraformaldehyde powder in PBS to the final concentration of 36%.b.Aliquot and store at −20°C.
CRITICAL: Paraformaldehyde must be handled under a chemical hood.

steps.title: Make 20× Tricaine stock
steps.instruction: Prepare a Tricaine euthanasia solution and add Tris buffer.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 1 g Tricaine in 244.75 mL MilliQ H₂O.
Dissolve 60.57 g Tris base in 450 mL MilliQ H₂O, adjust pH to 9 with HCl, and bring volume to 500 mL (1 M Tris).
Add 5.25 mL of the 1 M Tris solution to the Tricaine solution.
Store the final 20× Tricaine stock at 4 °C.

steps.title: Make TE buffer (genotyping)
steps.instruction: Prepare TE buffer for DNA extraction if genotyping is required.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 60.57 g Tris base in 450 mL MilliQ H₂O, adjust pH to 8 with HCl, and bring to 500 mL (1 M Tris).
Dissolve 73.06 g EDTA in 450 mL MilliQ H₂O, adjust pH to 8 with NaOH, and bring to 500 mL (0.5 M EDTA).
Add 5 mL of the 1 M Tris solution and 1 mL of the 0.5 M EDTA solution to 500 mL MilliQ H₂O.
Autoclave the mixture and store at 20‑22 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 60× E3 medium stock
steps.instruction: Make the concentrated E3 medium stock, autoclave, and keep at 4 °C; dilute to 1× in MilliQ H₂O before use.

steps.title: Prepare 10% KOH solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve solid KOH for tissue clearing and store.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 5 g KOH in 50 mL ddH₂O.
Store the 10 % (w/v) KOH solution at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare PBSTr washing buffer
steps.instruction: Make PBS containing 0.2 % Triton X‑100 for washing and permeabilization.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.2 % (v/v) Triton X‑100 to PBS (e.g., 100 µL Triton X‑100 to 50 mL PBS).
Store at 4 °C.
Handle undiluted Triton X‑100 under a chemical hood.

steps.title: Prepare PBSTr‑DMSO buffer
steps.instruction: Add 20 % DMSO to the PBSTr solution for enhanced permeabilization.

substeps.instruction: To 50 mL PBS add 100 µL Triton X‑100, 10 mL DMSO (20 % v/v).
Store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare PBSTr‑DMSO‑Tween buffer
steps.instruction: Add 0.1 % Tween‑20 to the PBSTr‑DMSO solution.

substeps.instruction: To 50 mL PBS add 100 µL Triton X‑100, 10 mL DMSO, and 50 µL Tween‑20 (0.1 % v/v).
Store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Make 150 mM Tris buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare Tris buffer (pH 9) for antigen retrieval.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 9.0855 g Tris base in 450 mL ddH₂O.
Adjust pH to 9 with HCl.
Transfer to a volumetric flask and bring to 500 mL with ddH₂O.
Aliquot into a clean sterile glass bottle.

steps.title: Prepare 2× GDB‑Tr blocking solution
steps.instruction: Make a gelatin‑Triton blocking solution and store frozen.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.4 % gelatin and 0.2 % Triton X‑100 to PBS (e.g., 10 mL gelatin solution + 100 µL Triton X‑100 to 50 mL PBS).
Aliquot and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Make PBST‑heparin washing solution
steps.instruction: Prepare PBS containing Tween‑20 and heparin to improve antibody diffusion.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.2 % Tween‑20 and 10 µg/mL heparin salt to PBS (e.g., 100 µL Tween‑20 and 50 µL of 10 mg/mL heparin stock to 50 mL PBS).
Store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare mounting medium
steps.instruction: Make a glycerol‑based mounting medium containing propyl gallate.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 1 g propyl gallate in 45 mL glycerol.
Add 5 mL PBS and mix with a magnetic stirrer.
Aliquot and store at –20 °C protected from light.

steps.title: Make 2% low‑melting agarose
steps.instruction: Prepare a 2 % low‑melting‑point agarose solution in 1× E3 for imaging.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve low‑melting‑point agarose in 1× E3 medium to a final concentration of 2 %.
If not used immediately, aliquot and store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 36% paraformaldehyde stock
steps.instruction: Make a 36 % paraformaldehyde solution in PBS for fixation.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve paraformaldehyde powder in PBS to a final concentration of 36 %.
Aliquot and store at –20 °C.
Handle paraformaldehyde under a chemical hood.

steps.title: Wash samples in PBST‑heparin
steps.instruction: Remove residual blocking solution by washing twice.

substeps.instruction: Incubate samples in PBST‑heparin for 1 h at 20‑22 °C.
Repeat for a second 1 h incubation at the same temperature.

steps.title: Incubate with primary antibody
steps.instruction: Apply rabbit polyclonal anti‑pRps6 antibody diluted in PBST‑heparin.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 1:200 dilution of the rabbit anti‑pRps6 antibody in PBST‑heparin.
Incubate samples with this solution for 72 h at 20‑22 °C.
Wash samples once in fresh PBST‑heparin (brief rinse).

steps.title: Overnight PBST‑heparin incubation
steps.instruction: Equilibrate samples in PBST‑heparin before secondary antibody.

substeps.instruction: Incubate samples in PBST‑heparin overnight (≈16 h) at 20‑22 °C.

steps.title: Incubate with secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Add Alexa Fluor 488 secondary antibody and incubate in darkness.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 1:1000 dilution of Alexa Fluor 488 secondary antibody in PBST‑heparin.
Remove the PBST‑heparin solution and add the secondary‑antibody solution.
Incubate for 48 h at 20‑22 °C in darkness (cover tube with aluminum foil).
From this point onward, keep samples protected from light.
If using an alternative blocking serum (goat or donkey), ensure the serum matches the host species of the secondary antibody.
